dialogues.speaker: Ma'chah
dialogues.text: I can feel it, I can feel it! Your "intensity"... It's impressive... truly impressive! So, what do you say? Want to take on the "Warrior's Challenge"?

choices.text: I'll need a moment to prepare.
Why are you trembling all over? Have you caught a chill?

response.speaker: Ma'chah
response.text: A chill? Nay, nay. I merely shiver in excitement at your "intensity"! Come, come then, challenge my record. Try to claim the title of "strongest in the Collective of Plenty" for yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Runa
dialogues.text: Hmm... Focusing too heavily on your goal when you run will lead you to overlook nearby hazards. That just won't do.

dialogues.speaker: Runa
dialogues.text: So, my philosophy is to put some things along the path that will... spice the challenge up a bit.
